description.narrative: By March 31, 2023. 1,000 teen boys and 200 men (fathers) have strengthened capacities to advocate for preventing of Child Sexual Abuse and 3,000 parents/carers (women) are strengthened to report and prevent Child Sexual Abuse.

comment.narrative: During the project implementation period 593 men were engaged in parenting training sessions focusing on child sexual abuse prevention and advocacy. Additionally 3142 women were engaged in parenting training sessions. 1128 boys were mobilized across schools in the target regions. Some of the boys facilitated community seminars at their schools focusing on child sexual abuse prevention.

comment.narrative: This project is a collaboration with Civil Society and Government hence two sources of data.
Fully met

Standard operating procedures were developed for key stakeholders in the child protection system Childcare and Protection Agency CPA ChildLinK. Additionally draft SOPs were developed for the Guyana Police Force and the National Toshao Council however senior leadership in these organizations have yet to approve these SOPs. Additionally the child protection system was strengthened with the addition of CACs in Lethem Reg 9 Mahdia Reg 8 and Whim and Springlands Reg 6. With these CACs the CAC services were now accessible to residents in these Regions. Thus services were strengthened. Additionally the CAC protocolsSOPs took effect in these Regions with the establishment of the CACs. Therefore practices was improved by the police who referred child sexual abuse cases to the CAC where children received services in line with international best practices. 9023 children were engaged in sensitization sessions providing them with knowledge that can help them to protect themselves from child sexual abuse. 593 men and 3142 women were trained to be advocates for the prevention of child sexual abuse. These trainings helped increased their knowledge on preventing child sexual abuse.

title.narrative: Three (3) Child Advocacy Centres established.

description.narrative: Three (3) Child Advocacy Centres in rural indigenous communities in Regions 6, 8 and 9 established to provide services to all least 100 victims of Child Sexual Abuse.

comment.narrative: Four 4 Child Advocacy Centers were established two in region 6 Whim and Springlands one in region 8 Mahdia and one in region 9 Lethem. The four 4 CACs are fully operational and staffed with trained counsellors and forensic interviewers. The CACs have established strong working relationship with key stakeholders such as the police and the Childcare and Protection Agency. The CACs have been adhering to the Child Advocacy Center protocols in collaboration with the police and CPA. During the implementation period 415 children 31 boys and 384 girls who were victims of child sexual abuse received counselling from the CACs. The CACs continue to receive annual government subvention ensuring sustainability of the services.
